questions.q: How many reading marks are there in Paper 2, and how many tasks?
questions.why: Section A has 5 tasks for 40 marks (6+6+8+10+10); the other 40 marks are for writing.

questions.q: Text: 'Obwohl der Bus vor der Tür hält, fährt Lena mit dem Rad.' How does Lena travel?
questions.why: obwohl signals the contrast: bus available, but she cycles.

questions.q: Which answer fits the question 'Wer hat angerufen?' (text: 'Gestern hat Georg angerufen')?
questions.why: Wer asks for a person: Georg.

questions.q: Name two ways of working out the meaning of an unknown German word.
questions.model: Split a compound noun into parts (e.g. Fahrradweg = bike + path), or use cognates/context/word family.
